"""Camera and proprioception controller for DexToolBench sharpie_marker/write_c.

The controller uses only service observations, calibrated RGB-D and joint state.
It makes a slow top-side pinch, then tracks the task's published goal sequence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

CAMERA = "oblique"
FRONT = "front"


def cloud(rgb, depth, camera_meta):
    """Convert a calibrated RGB-D image to world points (OpenGL camera frame)."""
    d = np.asarray(depth, dtype=np.float32).squeeze()
    h, w = d.shape
    intr = np.asarray(camera_meta["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(camera_meta["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    v, u = np.mgrid[:h, :w]
    z = np.nan_to_num(d, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    f = intr[0, 0]
    cam = np.stack(((u-intr[0,2])*z/f,
                    -(v-intr[1,2])*z/f,
                    -z), axis=-1)
    world = cam @ T[:3,:3].T + T[:3,3]
    return world, z


def visible_marker(obs):
    """Estimate marker center from dark pixels above the visible table plane."""
    rgb = obs.last[FRONT]
    pts, dep = cloud(rgb, obs.depth[FRONT][0], obs.meta["cameras"][FRONT])
    v, u = np.mgrid[:rgb.shape[0], :rgb.shape[1]]
    # The front view keeps the table top and marker in a compact central region.
    dark = (rgb.mean(2) < 155) & (rgb.min(2) > 35)
    roi = (u >= 132) & (u <= 194) & (v >= 120) & (v <= 165)
    on_table = (pts[:,:,2] > .515) & (pts[:,:,2] < .59)
    valid = dark & roi & on_table
    p = pts[valid]
    if len(p) < 8:
        return None
    # The median rejects the black cast shadow and the white robot fingers.
    return np.median(p, axis=0)


def fingertip_region(obs, center):
    """Return near-table white hand points in world coordinates."""
    rgb = obs.last[CAMERA]
    pts, dep = cloud(rgb, obs.depth[CAMERA][0], obs.meta["cameras"][CAMERA])
    v, u = np.mgrid[:rgb.shape[0], :rgb.shape[1]]
    white = rgb.min(2) > 190
    roi = (u > 100) & (u < 225) & (v > 50) & (v < 165)
    near = np.linalg.norm(pts[:,:,:2] - center[:2], axis=2) < .14
    mask = white & roi & near & (pts[:,:,2] > .535) & (pts[:,:,2] < .72) & (dep < 3)
    p = pts[mask]
    return p


def nearest_hand_point(obs, marker):
    p = fingertip_region(obs, marker)
    if len(p) == 0:
        return None
    # Closest visible contact surface is a useful approach feature for this pose.
    dist = np.linalg.norm(p - marker, axis=1)
    return p[np.argmin(dist)]


def close_hand(q, strength=1.0):
    """A four-finger wrap and opposing thumb, within HA4 joint limits."""
    h = np.array(q, dtype=float).copy()
    s = float(np.clip(strength, 0.0, 1.0))
    h[7:12] = np.array([1.15,.18,1.20,.12,1.0]) * s
    h[12:16] = np.array([1.15,.05,1.35,.95]) * s
    h[16:20] = np.array([1.10,.02,1.30,.90]) * s
    h[20:24] = np.array([1.00,.02,1.20,.85]) * s
    h[24:29] = np.array([.18,1.00,.05,1.15,.82]) * s
    return h


def open_hand(q):
    h = np.array(q, dtype=float).copy()
    h[7:] = 0.0
    return h


def move(r, q, dt=0.8, cams=("front", "oblique"), note=""):
    return r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(q, dtype=float), dt=dt,
                    cameras=cams, video="none", note=note)


def main():
    r = Robot()
    spec = r.spec()
    cams = [FRONT, CAMERA, "top"]
    lower = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["lower"], float)
    upper = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["upper"], float)
    dt = spec["control_dt"]

    try:
        obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
        while not obs.meta.get("done", False):
            now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
            q = now[58:87].copy()  # latest joint targets
            task = obs.meta["task"]
            marker = visible_marker(obs)
            if marker is None:
                obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, seconds=.25, include_depth=True, video="none")
                continue

            # Open-hand approach: image/depth residual to the marker supplies a
            # conservative local Cartesian correction through shoulder/elbow.
            tip = nearest_hand_point(obs, marker)
            if tip is not None:
                residual = marker + np.array([0.0, 0.0, .012]) - tip
                if np.linalg.norm(residual) > .018:
                    # Measured signs for the current iiwa tabletop posture.
                    dq = np.zeros(7)
                    dq[1] = np.clip(-residual[2] / .80, -.045, .045)
                    dq[3] = np.clip(residual[1] / .34, -.04, .04)
                    dq[5] = np.clip(-residual[2] / .35, -.04, .04)
                    q[:7] += dq
                    move(r, np.clip(q, lower, upper), dt=.7, cams=cams,
                         note="visual approach using calibrated RGB-D")
                    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
                    continue

            # Close at the visible contact region and lift in small increments.
            q = close_hand(q, 1.0)
            q = np.clip(q, lower, upper)
            move(r, q, dt=1.2, cams=cams, note="pinch visible marker")
            obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, seconds=.5, include_depth=True, video="none")
            if task.get("goals_reached", 0) == 0:
                now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
                q = now[58:87].copy()
                q[:7] = now[:7]
                q[1] -= .025
                move(r, q, dt=.6, cams=cams, note="incremental lift check")
            obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")

            # Once the service reports a goal transition, use its goal pose as
            # the task target. Depth and the visible green ghost remain the
            # feedback; the controller does not query simulator object state.
            if obs.meta["task"].get("goals_reached", 0) > task.get("goals_reached", 0):
                goal = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["goal"], float)
                now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
                q = now[58:87].copy()
                # Small damped joint corrections preserve the current grasp.
                q[1] += np.clip((goal[2] - marker[2]) * .25, -.025, .025)
                q[0] += np.clip((goal[0] - marker[0]) * .25, -.025, .025)
                q[3] += np.clip((goal[1] - marker[1]) * .20, -.025, .025)
                move(r, np.clip(q, lower, upper), dt=.6, cams=cams,
                     note=f"track goal {obs.meta['task']['goal_index']}")
                obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
    except EpisodeOver:
        pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
